levels.surface: أبو بكر محمد بن محمد بن علي الفقيه

notes: «في مسجد حميد» is a place where Abu Nasr narrated (rule 6), left out.

needs_ruling: a narrated encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts: Harith relates Ali's words and his own dialogue with the monk inside the story. Whether Ali is a source of the saying (imam_in_text) or only in the scene is not settled, so Ali is not written as a link.
The last link is Harith al-A'war, who relates the events; «علي بن أبي طالب» is named in the scene only.
